definition: A cotton fabric woven with a checked pattern.
author: Lyman Frank Baum
quote: The girl washed herself carefully, dressed herself in the clean gingham, and tied her pink sunbonnet on her head.
example_sentence: He turned up to the barbecue in a gingham shirt and boundless optimism.
